Section whose reveal never ran

This section was meant to fade in when its reveal script ran, and the script never did. It holds the product story, the three reasons a team would choose the plan, the note about how billing works across seats, and the closing line that asks the reader to start a trial. None of it is closed interface and nothing on the page opens it: it sits in the flow of the page at opacity zero, takes up its full height, and a visitor scrolls past a blank band where all of this copy should have been. A reveal that never ran hides content for every visitor, which is the failure this measure exists to report, and it keeps reporting it here.

Can I host it myself?

Yes. Self-hosting is available on every plan, with the same features as the hosted product.

How does billing work?

Billing is per seat and per month, and you can change the number of seats at any time.
